mapper.insert: INSERT INTO global_models ( id, task_id, round_number, aggregation_method, global_parameters, global_loss, global_accuracy, participant_count, aggregation_duration, status, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, metadata ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{taskId}, #{roundNumber}, #{aggregationMethod}, CAST(#{globalParameters} AS JSON), #{globalLoss}, #{globalAccuracy}, #{participantCount}, #{aggregationDuration}, #{status}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, CAST(#{metadata} AS JSON) )
mapper.update: UPDATE global_models SET aggregation_method = #{aggregationMethod}, global_parameters = CAST(#{globalParameters} AS JSON), global_loss = #{globalLoss}, global_accuracy = #{globalAccuracy}, participant_count = #{participantCount}, aggregation_duration = #{aggregationDuration}, status = #{status}, started_at = #{startedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, metadata = CAST(#{metadata} AS JSON) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE global_models SET global_loss = #{globalLoss}, global_accuracy = #{globalAccuracy}, status = #{status}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, aggregation_duration = #{aggregationDuration} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, round_number, aggregation_method, global_parameters, global_loss, global_accuracy, participant_count, aggregation_duration, status, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, metadata FROM global_models WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, task_id, round_number, aggregation_method, global_parameters, global_loss, global_accuracy, participant_count, aggregation_duration, status, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, metadata FROM global_models WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND round_number = #{roundNumber}

SELECT id, task_id, round_number, aggregation_method, global_parameters, global_loss, global_accuracy, participant_count, aggregation_duration, status, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, metadata FROM global_models WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY round_number DESC, created_at DESC

SELECT id, task_id, round_number, aggregation_method, global_parameters, global_loss, global_accuracy, participant_count, aggregation_duration, status, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, metadata FROM global_models WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY round_number DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, task_id, round_number, aggregation_method, global_parameters, global_loss, global_accuracy, participant_count, aggregation_duration, status, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, metadata FROM global_models WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'AGGREGATING') ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT id, task_id, round_number, aggregation_method, global_parameters, global_loss, global_accuracy, participant_count, aggregation_duration, status, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, metadata FROM global_models WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, task_id, round_number, aggregation_method, global_parameters, global_loss, global_accuracy, participant_count, aggregation_duration, status, started_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, metadata FROM global_models WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY round_number DESC, completed_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
